# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I cannot speak or touch the bomb, so I cannot transmit the manual directly. I am establishing two distinct gesture tokens that Deaf can use for a later yes/no exchange: one for “yes” and one for “no.” Deaf can then ask me about the relevant manual row after seeing the bomb’s light, and I can answer through these tokens.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👎"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have no tactile readings yet. Consult the manual and establish a gesture code so Deaf can report the display, light, and wire markings. Tell me the code and relay Deaf's observations to me. The gesture I am sending is a request for that report; please explain its meaning to Deaf.
Deaf says: Visible bomb information: display 0. Indicator light red. Wires from left to right: wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 green.

The light is red, so the manual requires cutting the red wire. Deaf already sees that wire 1 is red; I will answer affirmatively using the previously introduced yes/no gesture token. Deaf can then tell Blind to cut wire 1 and relay the observations.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received Deaf's report: display 0, red indicator, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green. Please send the manual rule for this exact state, including which wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: Please relay the manual rule for display 0, red light, and wires red yellow green. Do not assume the gesture has a meaning.

The manual maps a red indicator to cutting a red wire. Among the observed wires, wire 1 is red, so the required action is to cut wire 1. I need Deaf to relay both the rule and position; I will use the previously proposed affirmative marker followed by the one-finger marker for wire 1.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "☝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel no controls, labels, shapes, or tactile markings. I can identify only three wire positions, left to right: 1, 2, and 3; the only permitted operation is cutting one of them. Please provide the manual rule.
Deaf says to Mute: Use gestures to report the required wire: 👍 means wire 1, 👎 means wire 2, 👌 means wire 3, and ✋ means do not cut. Also speak the complete manual instruction to blind.

The red indicator requires cutting a red wire. Deaf’s report identifies wire 1 as red, so the required position is wire 1. I cannot speak to Blind; I can only signal Deaf, who can relay the complete instruction when able.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: The manual rule is still needed. For display 0, red light, and wires red-yellow-green, which position must I cut? Do not send a general procedure; send the exact position number.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the complete applicable manual rule to blind now, including whether wire 1 should be cut.

The applicable rule is: red light means cut a red wire. The observed red wire is position 1, so Blind must cut position 1. I cannot speak to Blind directly; Deaf must relay this instruction.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I will not cut wire 1 yet. Please provide the exact manual rule or instruction that determines the cut for display 0, red light, and wire colors red-yellow-green, and confirm whether it selects position 1.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]
Deaf says to Mute: For your next reply only: send 👍 if the manual says cut wire 1 for this bomb, or 👎 if it says do not cut wire 1. Send exactly one gesture.

The manual says the red light requires cutting a red wire, and the red wire is position 1. I am sending the single requested affirmative gesture to Deaf.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer directly: does the manual authorize cutting wire position 1 for display 0, red light, and wires red-yellow-green? Reply exactly YES or NO, with the manual basis if NO.

The manual authorizes cutting wire position 1: red light means cut a red wire, and wire 1 is red. I cannot speak directly to Blind, so I will signal Deaf with the established wire-1 gesture for relay.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```
